remarks: Bring your contractor and your vision to 7 Hillwood Place. Tucked away in one of Norwalk's most desirable pockets, this property is the ultimate blank canvas for your next big project. Whether you're looking to take on a full-scale renovation or start fresh with a custom build, the potential here is undeniable.  The existing structure is ready for a complete overhaul, but the real value lies in the land and the prime location. It's a rare chance to secure a building lot in a neighborhood known for its coastal charm and proximity to the vibrant energy of SoNo. Just moments from top-tier dining and easy transit, this is the perfect spot to create a home tailored exactly to your lifestyle. Opportunities like this don't last-bring your architect and unlock the possibilities. House is being sold in "as is" condition.
